trophies.name: ARMS Master
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: Reaching Out
trophies.description: Win your first match in any mode.

trophies.name: Hands On
trophies.description: Grab an opponent during a match.

trophies.name: Fully Charged
trophies.description: Land a hit with charged ARMS.

trophies.name: Rush Hour
trophies.description: Finish an opponent with a Rush attack.

trophies.name: Counterpuncher

trophies.name: Out of Bounds
trophies.description: Win a match by knocking your opponent out of the ring.

trophies.name: Home Court Disadvantage
trophies.description: Defeat an opponent using a stage hazard.

trophies.description: Clear Grand Prix on Level 1.

trophies.description: Clear Grand Prix on Level 4 to unlock Ranked Match.

trophies.name: Heads Will Roll
trophies.description: Defeat Hedlok in Grand Prix.

trophies.name: Grand Champion
trophies.description: Clear Grand Prix on Level 7.

trophies.name: Doctor's Orders
trophies.description: Defeat Dr. Coyle on Level 7 and see the true ending.

trophies.name: Fifteen and Oh
trophies.description: Clear Grand Prix on Level 7 with every fighter.

trophies.name: Roster Rotation
trophies.description: Win a match with each of the ten starting fighters.

trophies.name: Muscle Memory
trophies.description: Unlock Max Brass as a playable fighter.

trophies.name: Spring Cleaning
trophies.description: Unlock Springtron as a playable fighter.

trophies.description: Win a match with all fifteen fighters.

trophies.description: Collect every ARM for a single fighter.

trophies.name: Armed to the Teeth
trophies.description: Collect every ARM for every fighter.

trophies.name: Odd Pair
trophies.description: Win a match using two different ARMS at once.

trophies.name: Sharpshooter

trophies.name: Spring Serve
trophies.description: Win a game of V-Ball.

trophies.name: Slam Dunk
trophies.description: Win a game of Hoops.

trophies.name: Six-Armed and Dangerous
trophies.description: Win a round of Hedlok Scramble.

trophies.name: One Against the World
trophies.description: Defeat all opponents in 1-on-100.

trophies.name: Party Crasher

trophies.name: Fashionably Late

trophies.name: Punch-Drunk
trophies.description: Land 1,000 punches across all your matches.

trophies.description: Play 100 matches in any mode.

trophies.name: Tag Team
trophies.description: Win a 2-on-2 team match.

trophies.name: Flawless Victory
trophies.description: Win a round without losing any health.

trophies.name: Down to the Wire
